title: Canonical lift cocycle quotient for hypercohomology edge
statement: For the canonical lift of G applied to the cycle inclusion of a natural-indexed cochain complex, the hypercohomology left edge composed with the homology quotient equals G applied to the original homology quotient.

proof.text: Form the genuine cochain map from the single complex on Z^n(K) in degree n to K using its cycle inclusion. Prove its induced map on cycles is the canonical lift and its map on homology is the homology quotient, using monicity of cycle inclusions and homology quotient naturality. Apply left-edge naturality to this cochain map, normalize the single-complex edge, cancel G of the single homology isomorphism, and associate the composites.

proof_origin.note: H3: single-degree normalization and naturality; canonical cycle and quotient transport proved in Lean.

lean.statement:
theorem cochainHypercohomologyLeftEdge_canonical
    {B : Type uB} [Category.{vB} B] [Abelian B] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{vB} B]
    {C : Type uC} [Category.{vC} C] [Abelian C] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{vC} C]
    [HasDerivedCategory B] [HasDerivedCategory C]
    (G : B ⥤ C) [G.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits G]
    (K : CochainComplex B ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    (let T := ((G.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj K)
     let c := T.liftCycles (G.map (K.iCycles n)) (n + 1) (by simp)
       (by
         change G.map (K.iCycles n) ≫ G.map (K.d n (n + 1)) = 0
         rw [← G.map_comp, K.iCycles_d, G.map_zero])
     c ≫ T.homologyπ n ≫ G.cochainHypercohomologyLeftEdge K n =
       G.map (K.homologyπ n))
